title: Very waterproof
text: Very waterproof. The quilting/padding is minimal but it does appear to be very waterproof so I'm happy. I bought this to protect my mattress from my puppy.

product_metadata.title: Safe and Sound Quilted Fitted Cal King Mattress Pad Cover, Waterproof Mattress Protector, Deep Pocket Elastic Fits Up to 21 Inch, Breathable Soft Alternative Filling Mattress Pad
features: 100% WATERPROOF: Our california king mattress protector have an upgraded TPU membrane to provide waterproof protection. Our cal king mattress pad is ideal for elders, periods, pets, bedwetting, etc. No more frustration about accidents happening.

COMFORTABLE & NOISELESS: The cal king mattress pad are silent and comfortable. The high-quality microfiber surface brings a soft touching feeling to provide superior comfort. When you sleep on our quiet waterproof mattress pad, you won't hear loud plastic noise like other products.

FITTED SHEET STYLE: Cal King size mattress cover waterproof (72”x84”) with a durable elastic band perfectly fits the mattress 8-21" in depth and hold your mattress tight. The deep pocket design is easy to install and remove. When accidents happen, the mattress pad will stay in every corner without any slides.

MACHINE WASHABLE: Easy to clean with cold water on a gentle cycle, and tumble dry low to extend product service life. Do not iron and bleach. The mattress pad can be used in homes, hotels, hospitals, dorms, etc. We offer a 90-day full refund with no questions asked and 24-hour customer service.
